normalization: NFKC; lowercase; curly apostrophe to ASCII; replace non a-z/0-9/apostrophe with space; collapse whitespace; trim
hash: unsigned FNV-1a 32-bit over UTF-8 bytes; initial 2166136261, multiply 16777619 using Math.imul; modulo 8192; no sign
features: w:word unigrams; b:word1 space word2 bigrams; c3:/c4:/c5: character grams over ^normalized$ including spaces
vector: positive counts then L2 normalization, float32 sparse/dense values; empty input all zero
binary: little-endian float32 row-major 13x8192 weights then 13 biases
